As the threshold increases, the frequency of the retrieval module’s activation decreases, suggesting that adjusting the threshold can strike a balance between the system’s efficiency and the accuracy of its outputs in practical applications. DRAGIN also triggers retrieval when the maximum token-level entropy within a reasoning step exceeds a calibrated threshold.
